name: Blightseep Fields
desc:
A Blightseep Field formed by the filth spilling forth from the Abyssal rifts. Within the corrupted area, characters will continuously lose HP. Objects that coexist with kuuvahki will become Blighted due to its influence.
Upon eliminating the Abyssal Entities in the area, the corruption will also dissipate.
